ei.title: Education in Ancient Greece: Personal and Communal Learning
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: In ancient Greece, education consistently occurred in the context of the personal relations among teachers and students. Most often, it involved a tutor who traveled to homes or other community locations where they worked with individuals or small groups of students. Additionally, collecting teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating a social learning context, such as Plato's Academy and its descendent organizations. It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as essential: "advanced education involved a deep and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, supported the active engagement of students in learning. Much of what was learned occurred through these interpersonal oral relationships rather than through written materials.

questions.passage: In ancient Greece, education consistently occurred in the context of the (A)[personal / impersonal] relations among teachers and students. Most often, it involved a tutor who traveled to homes or other community locations where they worked with individuals or small groups of students. Additionally, collecting teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating a social learning context, such as Plato's Academy and its descendent organizations. It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as (B)[essential / optional]: "advanced education involved a deep and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, supported the active engagement of students in learning. Much of what was learned occurred through these interpersonal (C)[oral / written] relationships rather than through written materials.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① personal - essential - oral = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② impersonal(비인격적인): 교사와 학생 사이의 '개인적' 관계라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ③ optional(선택적인): 교사-학생 간 친밀한 관계가 '필수적'으로 여겨졌다는 원문과 모순
❌ ④ written(서면의): 구두 관계를 통해 배웠다는 원문과 정반대
det.tip: personal relations(개인적 관계), seen as essential(필수적이라 여김), oral relationships(구두 관계)가 본문의 핵심 3어이다.

questions.passage: In ancient Greece, education consistently occurred in the context of the personal relations among teachers and students. Most often, it involved a tutor who (A)[traveled / remained] to homes or other community locations where they worked with individuals or small groups of students. Additionally, collecting teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating a social learning context, such as Plato's Academy and its descendent organizations. It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as essential: "advanced education involved a deep and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a (B)[considerable / negligible] part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, supported the active (C)[engagement / withdrawal] of students in learning. Much of what was learned occurred through these interpersonal oral relationships rather than through written materials.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① remained(머물렀다): 가정교사가 집으로 '이동했다'는 원문과 반대
❌ ② negligible(무시할 만한): 감정이 '상당한' 역할을 했다는 원문과 반대
✅ ③ traveled - considerable - engagement = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ withdrawal(철회): 학생의 '적극적 참여'를 지지했다는 원문과 정반대
det.tip: tutor who traveled(이동한 가정교사), played a considerable part(상당한 역할), active engagement(적극적 참여)가 핵심 표현이다.

questions.passage: In ancient Greece, education consistently occurred in the context of the personal relations among teachers and students. Most often, it involved a tutor who traveled to homes or other community locations where they worked with individuals or small groups of students. Additionally, (A)[collecting / dispersing] teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating a social learning context, such as Plato's Academy and its descendent organizations. It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as essential: "advanced education involved a (B)[deep / shallow] and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, supported the active engagement of students in learning. Much of what was learned occurred through these (C)[interpersonal / institutional] oral relationships rather than through written materials.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① dispersing(흩뜨리는): 교사와 학생을 학습 공동체로 '모으는' 것이라는 원문과 반대
✅ ② collecting - deep - interpersonal = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ shallow(얕은): 교사와 학생 사이의 '깊고 절대적으로 개인적인' 유대라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ④ institutional(기관의): 대인 간 구두 관계를 통해 배웠다는 원문과 어긋남
det.tip: collecting teachers and students(교사와 학생을 모으는), a deep and absolutely personal bond(깊고 절대적으로 개인적인 유대), interpersonal oral relationships(대인 간 구두 관계)가 본문 논리의 핵심이다.

Most often, it involved a tutor who traveled to homes or other community locations where they worked with individuals or small groups of students. Additionally, collecting teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating a social learning context, such as Plato's Academy and its descendent organizations. It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as ③<u>trivial</u>: "advanced education involved a deep and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, supported the ④<u>active</u> engagement of students in learning. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① consistently(일관되게): 교육이 개인적 관계 맥락에서 '일관되게' 일어났다는 의미로 적절
✅ ② personal(개인적인): 교사와 학생 간의 '개인적' 관계를 가리켜 적절
❌ ③ trivial → essential: 교사-학생 간 친밀한 관계가 '필수적(essential)'이라 여겨졌다는 원문과 정반대 ←정답
✅ ④ active(적극적인): 플라톤이 학생의 '적극적' 참여를 지지했다는 의미로 적절
det.tip: seen as essential(필수적이라 여겨진)과 trivial(사소한)은 정반대 의미이다.

It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as essential: "advanced education involved a deep and absolutely personal ③<u>bond</u> between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, ④<u>supported</u> the active engagement of students in learning. Much of what was learned occurred through these interpersonal oral relationships rather than through written materials.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① community(공동체): 가정교사가 '공동체' 장소로 이동했다는 의미로 적절
❌ ② obstacle → approach: 학습 공동체를 만드는 '접근법(approach)'이라는 원문에서 '장애물'은 정반대 ←정답
✅ ③ bond(유대): 교사와 학생 사이의 깊은 '유대'를 가리켜 적절
✅ ④ supported(지지하다): 플라톤이 학생 참여를 '지지했다'는 의미로 적절
det.tip: another approach to creating(~을 만드는 또 다른 접근법)에서 approach와 obstacle은 정반대이다.

✅ ① traveled(이동했다): 가정교사가 집으로 '이동했다'는 의미로 적절

questions.passage:
(A) In this bond between teacher and pupil, emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part. The emotional connection was central to the learning experience.
(B) He decided to part with his old collection of books and donate them to the local library before moving abroad.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 part의 의미로 가장 적절하게 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) '부분'보다는 played a part에서 '역할'이 더 정확한 뜻
❌ ② (B) part with는 '헤어지다/떠나보내다'이지 '부분'이 아님
❌ ③ 둘 다 '부분'으로 보는 것은 (A)에서 play a part의 관용적 의미를, (B)에서 part with의 의미를 놓침
✅ ④ (A) played a considerable part = '상당한 역할'의 part / (B) part with = '~과 헤어지다/떠나보내다' ←정답
det.tip: play a part = 역할을 하다 (명사). part with = ~와 헤어지다/~을 떠나보내다 (동사). 같은 철자이지만 품사와 의미가 다르다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a close connection or tie between people, based on shared feelings, interests, or experiences"

det.korean: 유대, 결속 — 공유된 감정과 경험에 기반한 사람 간의 긴밀한 연결
det.analysis:
✅ ① bond(유대): 공유된 감정·관심·경험에 기반한 사람들 사이의 긴밀한 연결을 뜻하여 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ② context(맥락): 사건이 일어나는 배경이라 정의와 다름
❌ ③ approach(접근법): 방법론을 뜻하며 사람 간 연결이 아님
❌ ④ passion(열정): 강한 감정이지 사람 간의 '연결'이 아님
det.tip: bond는 'a deep and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil'처럼 사람 간의 '유대·결속'을 가리킨다.

questions.passage: Additionally, collecting teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating a social learning context, such as Plato's Academy and its __________ (descend) organizations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 'its ___ organizations'에서 organizations를 수식하는 형용사/명사 역할이 필요하므로 동사 'descend'를 'descendent(후속의)'로 바꿔야 한다. descendent와 descendant는 모두 허용되는 철자이다.
det.tip: descend(내려오다) → descendent/descendant(후속의, 후예의). 원문 그대로 descendent 철자를 사용한다.

questions.passage: It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was __________ (consist) seen as essential.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 'was ___ seen as essential'에서 수동태 동사 'seen'을 수식하는 부사가 필요하므로 'consist'에서 파생된 부사 'consistently(일관되게)'로 바꿔야 한다. consistent(형용사) → consistently(부사).
det.tip: consist → consistent(일관된, 형용사) → consistently(일관되게, 부사). 동사를 수식하는 부사 형태를 써야 한다.

questions.passage: In ancient Greece, education consistently occurred in the context of the personal relations among teachers and students. Most often, it involved a tutor who traveled to homes or other community locations where they worked with individuals or small groups of students. Additionally, collecting teachers and students into learning communities was another approach to creating __________, such as Plato's Academy and its descendent organizations. It is important to note that a close relationship between student and teacher was consistently seen as essential: "advanced education involved a deep and absolutely personal bond between teacher and pupil, a bond in which ... emotion, if not passion, played a considerable part." Indeed, Plato, in the Dialogues, supported the active engagement of students in learning. Much of what was learned occurred through these interpersonal oral relationships rather than through written materials.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사회적 학습 맥락 — 플라톤의 아카데미처럼 교사와 학생을 모아 만드는 학습 환경
det.analysis:
❌ ① the personal relations among teachers(교사들 사이의 개인적 관계): 1문장에서 교육이 일어난 '맥락'이지 학습 공동체를 통해 '만드는' 대상이 아님
❌ ② a deep and absolutely personal bond(깊고 절대적으로 개인적인 유대): 교사-학생 관계의 성격이지 학습 공동체의 '목적'이 아님
✅ ③ a social learning context(사회적 학습 맥락): 교사와 학생을 학습 공동체로 모아 만드는 대상으로 문맥에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ the active engagement of students(학생의 적극적 참여): 플라톤이 지지한 것이지 학습 공동체를 통해 '만드는' 것이 아님
det.tip: another approach to creating a social learning context(사회적 학습 맥락을 만드는 또 다른 접근법)는 플라톤의 아카데미와 같은 학습 공동체를 설명한다.

det.korean: 서면 자료를 통해 — 구두 관계와 대비되는 학습 수단
det.analysis:
❌ ① through the personal relations among teachers(교사 간의 개인적 관계를 통해): 교육이 일어난 '맥락'이지 구두 관계와 대비되는 수단이 아님
✅ ② through written materials(서면 자료를 통해): 구두 관계를 통해 배웠지 서면 자료를 통해서가 아니라는 대비 구조에 정확히 부합 ←정답

❌ ④ in other community locations(다른 공동체 장소에서): 가정교사가 이동한 장소이지 학습 수단이 아님
det.tip: rather than through written materials(서면 자료를 통해서가 아니라)는 구두 관계 중심의 고대 그리스 교육을 대비적으로 설명하는 결론 구문이다.
